senses.gloss:
1. हेमन्, आ, m. (according to Śabda-k. also अ
neut.), winter; cold, the cold season; the planet
Mercury, (see हिम-रश्मि-ज.)

हेमन् 2. हेमन्, अ, n. (according to Uṇādi-s.
IV. 144. fr. rt. 1. हि, perhaps connected with 1. हरि-
मन्, ‘yellowness,’ p. 1167; cf. प्र-उग for प्र-
युग; or perhaps connected with हिम, 1. हेमन्
at pp. 1172, 1173), gold; water, (in Naigh. I. 2.
enumerated among the हिरण्य-नामानि, and in I.
12. among the उदक-नामानि); the thorn-apple;
the Keśara flower.
—हेम-कक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्,
having a golden girdle; having golden walls.
—हेम-
कन्दल, अस्, m. ‘having golden shoots,’ coral.
—हेम-कर, अस्, m. a gold-worker, gold-
smith; epithet of Śiva.
—हेम-कर्तृ, ता, m. a
goldsmith; a kind of bird.
—हेम-कान्ति, इस्, इस्, इ,
having a golden lustre; (इस्), f. a kind of Curcuma
(= दारु-हरिद्रा).
—हेम-कार, अस्, m. a gold-
worker, goldsmith.
—हेम-किञ्जल्क, अम्, n. ‘hav-
ing golden filaments,’ the Nāga-keśara flower.
—हे-
म-किरीट-मालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, garlanded with a diadem
of gold.
—हेम-कुम्भ, अस्, m. a golden jar.
—हेम-कूट, अस्, m. ‘golden-peaked,’ (perhaps
also connected with 1. हेमन् at p. 1173, col. 1),
one of the ranges of mountains dividing the known
continent into nine Varṣas, (supposed to be situated
north of Himālaya and forming with it the boundaries
of the Kinnara or Kimpuruṣa Varṣa, see वर्ष.)
—हेम-केतकी, f. a kind of tree (= स्वर्ण-
केतकी).
—हेम-केलि, इस्, m. ‘golden-sport,’ epithet
of Agni or fire.
—हेम-केश, अस्, m. ‘golden-
haired,’ Śiva.
—हेम-क्षीरी, f. the plant Svarṇa-
kṣīrī, q. v.
—हेम-गन्धिनी, f. the perfume Re-
ṇukā.
—हेम-गौर, अस्, ई, अम्, of a golden yellow
colour; (अस्), m. the Kiṅkirāta tree.
—हेमगौ-
राङ्ग (˚र-अङ्˚), अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having limbs or a
body of a golden yellow colour.
—हेम-चक्र, अस्,
आ, अम्, golden-wheeled, having wheels of gold.
—हेम-चन्द्र, अस्, m. a golden or golden-
coloured moon; N. of a king of Vaiśālī; of a phi-
losopher; of a celebrated lexicographer and author
(son of Jaya-siṃha-deva, author of the Abhidhāna-
cintāmaṇi lexicon; of the Uṇādi-vṛtti; of a Dhātu-
pāṭha; of the Vibhrama-sūtra; of a Prākṛt gram-
mar; of the Chandaś-cūḍāmaṇi, &c.).
—हेम-
च्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with gold; (अम्), n.
a golden covering, golden trappings (of an elephant
&c.).
—हेम-जीवन्ती, f. a kind of plant (= स्वर्ण-
जीवन्ती).
—हेम-ज्वाल, अस्, m. ‘golden-flamed,’
fire.
—हेम-तरु, उस्, m. ‘golden tree,’ the Datura
or thorn-apple.
—हेम-तार, अम्, n. = हेम-सार,
blue vitriol (= तुत्थ).
—हेम-दुग्ध, अस्, m.
‘having golden or yellow juice,’ the glomerous fig-
tree; (आ), f. the plant Svarṇa-kṣīrī; (ई), f. the plant
Svarṇa-kṣīrī; a kind of tree (= यज्ञोडुम्बर).
—हेम-दुग्धक, अस्, इका, अम्, having golden
or yellow juice; (अस्), m. = हेम-दुग्ध above.
—हेम-नाभि, इस्, इस्, इ, having a golden nave or
centre.
—हेम-पर्वत, अस्, m. ‘golden-mountain,’
the mountain Meru.
—हेम-पीठाधिदेवता (˚ठ-
अध्˚), f. the tutelary deity of a golden foot-stool,
(epithet of a monarch's foot.)
—हेम-पुष्प, अस्,
m. ‘bearing golden flowers,’ the Campaka tree; the
Lodhra tree; (ई), f. Bengal madder; other plants,
= स्वर्ण-जीवन्ती, इन्द्र-वारुणी, स्वर्णुली, मु-
षली, कण्टकारी; (अम्), n. the Aśoka flower; the
flower of the China rose.
—हेम-पुष्पक, अस्,
m. the Campaka tree; the Lodhra tree; (इका), f.
the golden or yellow jasmine.
—हेम-फल, अस्, आ,
अम्, having golden fruit; (आ), f. a kind of plantain
(= स्वर्ण-कदली).
—हेम-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
made or consisting of gold, golden.
—हेम-माला,
f. a golden garland; ‘golden-garlanded,’ the wife of
Yama.
—हेम-मालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a golden
[]
garland, golden-crowned; (ई), m. the sun.
—हेम-
मृग, अस्, m. a golden deer, (according to a popular
legend, the Rākṣasa Mārīca transformed himself
into a golden deer and so captivated Rāma-candra
and his wife Sītā, that the former left his cottage
in the forest to pursue the beautiful animal; during
his absence the Rākṣasa Rāvaṇa, q. v., disguised as
a mendicant, presented himself before Sītā and
carried her off; the whole story is told in the third
book or Araṇya-kāṇḍa of the Rāmāyaṇa.)
—हेम-
यूथिका, f. the golden or yellow jasmine.
—हेम-
रत्न-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consisting of gold
and gems.
—हेम-रागिणी, f. ‘gold-coloured,’ tur-
meric.
—हेम-राज, अस्, m. a proper N.
—हेम-
रेणु, उस्, उ, m. n. ‘golden-dust,’ a sort of atom;
[cf. सु-रेणु, त्रस-र्˚.]
—हेम-लता, f. ‘golden-
creeper,’ a kind of plant (= स्वर्ण-जीवन्ती).
—हे-
म-लम्ब or हेम-लम्बक, अस्, m. epithet of
the fifth (or thirty-first) year of Jupiter's cycle of sixty
years.
—हेम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, golden.
—हेम-
व्याकरण, अम्, n., N. of a work on grammar by
Hema-sūri or Hema-candra.
—हेम-शङ्ख, अस्,
m. ‘having a golden conch,’ Viṣṇu.
—हेम-
शिखा, f. ‘gold-crested,’ the plant Svarṇa-kṣīrī, q. v.
—हेम-शृङ्ग, अम्, n. a golden horn; a golden
peak or summit.
—हेम-शृङ्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, golden-
horned, golden-peaked.
—हेम-सार, अम्, n. blue
vitriol or sulphate of copper; [cf. हेम-तार.]
—हेम-सूत्र or हेम-सूत्रक, अम्, n. ‘gold-
string,’ a kind of necklace.
—हेम-सूरि, इस्, m.,
N. of a grammarian (= हेम-चन्द्र).
—हेम-
हस्ति-रथ, अस्, m. ‘golden-elephant-chariot,’ N.
of one of the sixteen Mahā-dānas; [cf. हिरण्याश्व-
रथ.]
—हेमाङ्ग (˚म-अङ्˚), अम्, n. a golden
body; (अस्, आ or ई, अम्), having a golden body,
golden-limbed, golden; (अस्), m. Garuḍa; a lion;
the mountain Su-meru; Brahmā; Viṣṇu; the Cam-
paka tree.
—हेमाङ्ग-द, अस्, m., N. of a Gan-
dharva.
—हेमाढ्य (˚म-आढ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
abounding in gold.
—हेमाद्रि (˚म-अद्˚), इस्, m.
‘golden-mountain,’ (perhaps also connected with
1. हेमन् at p. 1173, col. 1), the mountain Su-
meru; N. of a Kṣatriya king, (according to Śabda-k.
author of the Cintāmaṇi-kāmadhenu-kalpadruma-
smṛti-saṅgraha; also author of the Harilīlā-viveka
and of a commentary on the Aṣṭāṅga-hṛdaya-
saṃhitā, &c.); N. of a work.
—हेमाद्रि-जरण,
अस्, m. the plant Svarṇa-kṣīrī, q. v.
—हेमाम्भोज
(˚म-अम्˚), अम्, n. a golden lotus-flower.
—हे-
माह्व (˚म-आह्˚), अस्, m. ‘called after gold,’ the
wild Campaka tree; the thorn-apple; (आ), f. a kind
of plant (= स्वर्ण-जीवन्ती).

हेमन्त, अस्, अम्, m. n. winter, the cold season
(comprising the two months Agra-hāyaṇa and Pauṣa,
i. e. from middle of November to middle of January).
—हेमन्त-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of winter,’ the
wood-apple tree (= कपित्थ).
हेमन्ती, f. the winter season, cold season.
हेमवल, अम्, n. a pearl (= हिमवल).

हेम्ना, m. (according to Śabda-k.) the planet
Mercury.

हेम, अम्, n. (abbreviated fr. 2. हेमन्, col. 1),
gold; (अस्), m. a horse of a dark or brownish colour
[cf. हरिय, p. 1167]; a particular weight of gold
(= माषक); N. of the father of Su-tapas; of a
king; = हेम-चन्द्र, q. v.; (आ), f. a handsome
woman; an Apsaras of Indra's heaven; N. of a
river.

हेमल, अस्, m. a goldsmith; a chameleon, lizard;
the touchstone.

हेम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, golden, made of gold.
—हे-
म्या-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having golden trappings,
(Sāy. = सुवर्ण-निर्मित-कक्ष्यावत्, having a
girth made of gold, Ṛg-veda IV. 2, 8.)
